reader_summary.overview: with @andrewchen @dcoolican and @smc90 This is episode #3 of our new show, 16 Minutes, where we quickly cover recent headlines of the week. This week we do a short but deep dive on esports, given recent news of the inaugural Fortnite World Cup champion. Our a16z experts in this episode are general partner Andrew Chen and investing team partner D'Arcy Coolican, both of the consumer vertical.
